scientific_integrity: A complete mathematical proof and a finite exact-arithmetic checker are supplied. Finite checks do not replace the proof. Priority relative to older general deviation-vector literature requires independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for powers of two, multiplicative cosets of unit subgroups, and their first moments; no assertion for arbitrary even moduli or incomplete sums. The group decomposition is classical; earlier implicit derivations remain a priority risk.
title: The complete first-moment spectrum of multiplicative cosets modulo powers of two
